verdict.rationale: Sentry's web API docs state the API can be used to 'manage and export data', and self-hosting gives users a documented way to run all of Sentry themselves, which community users describe as an escape hatch from lock-in. There is no evidence of a complete bulk export or of specific open export formats. The relocation tooling cited only covers moving from self-hosted to SaaS, not leaving Sentry. Missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export, named open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/OTLP egress), outbound migration or offboarding tooling, and hands-on corroboration that a complete export works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.
